![What Is a Tennis Bracelet and Why Is It Called That? | Borsheims](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09290840-2330-0066-0000-0de4cd86124b:4)
A tennis bracelet is `a thin, flexible piece of jewelry made with a continuous, symmetrical row of matching diamonds or gemstones set closely together`.[[1]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/education/what-is-a-tennis-bracelet/)[[2]](https://www.vogue.com/article/the-dramatic-sport-story-that-inspired-the-tennis-bracelet)[[3]](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/what-is-a-tennis-bracelet/)

### Design and Features

- **Continuous Line:** It features identically sized and matched stones (traditionally diamonds) linked edge-to-edge with no large centerpiece.[[1]](https://www.monicavinader.com/us/blog/news-and-events/what-is-a-tennis-bracelet)[[2]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/education/what-is-a-tennis-bracelet/)
- **Flexibility:** The individual metal settings articulate smoothly so the strand drapes fluidly around the wrist.[[1]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/education/what-is-a-tennis-bracelet/)
- **Secure Clasp:** They typically use a box clasp paired with a safety latch (like a figure-eight) to prevent loss during movement.[[1]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/education/what-is-a-tennis-bracelet/)
- **Materials:** While traditionally made with diamonds in gold or platinum, modern versions feature lab-grown diamonds, colored gemstones (like sapphires or emeralds), or cubic zirconia set in silver or stainless steel.[[1]](https://us.pandora.net/en/blog/what-is-a-tennis-bracelet/)[[2]](https://www.vogue.com/article/the-dramatic-sport-story-that-inspired-the-tennis-bracelet)[[3]](https://johnatencio.com/pages/glossary-tennis-bracelets)[[4]](https://www.sterlingforever.com/blogs/news/what-is-a-tennis-bracelet)

### Why Is It Called a Tennis Bracelet?
The style was originally called a "diamond line bracelet" or "eternity bracelet". It was renamed during the 1987 U.S. Open when professional tennis champion **Chris Evert** lost her diamond line bracelet mid-match. She asked officials to pause play so she could find her missing piece on the court, creating an iconic televised moment that permanently tied the jewelry style to the sport.[[1]](https://www.borsheims.com/blog/what-is-a-tennis-bracelet/)[[2]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/education/what-is-a-tennis-bracelet/)[[3]](https://www.vogue.com/article/the-dramatic-sport-story-that-inspired-the-tennis-bracelet)[[4]](https://us.pandora.net/en/blog/what-is-a-tennis-bracelet/)[[5]](https://www.facebook.com/ShivasJewelers/videos/everyone-knows-this-is-called-the-tennis-bracelet-but-have-you-ever-wondered-whe/26100249589625821/)If you're shopping for one, would you like to know more about **carat weight sizing**, **prong vs. bezel settings** , or **price ranges**?
